overview:
David Joyce seeks another term in this northeastern Ohio district, which leans Republican by about ten points. He enters the general election with a large financial edge, holding $3.1 million on hand after raising $1.4 million, while Democrat Maria Jukic has raised roughly $62,000 and has minimal cash available. No outside groups are actively opposing Joyce.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings cover this race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, incumbency, and the money gap. Prediction markets give Joyce about a 96% chance of winning. The race is rated Likely Republican, with limited uncertainty given the absence of contrary evidence.
